summary.intent: Keep the monokl project moving: land the declared-name change (PR #96), investigate a suspected stress/many benchmark slowdown, and begin ADR 0005 (span-based hits and block tree).
summary.outcome: PR #96 merged (CodeBlock.name filled by TS/JS and Rust analyzers, name_match_boost uses it) and release PR #97 is open. The bisect found no single regression over 15%, only a cumulative ~12% slowdown (#83 +5%, #88 +7%), which was accepted. A subagent was started on the first ADR 0005 PR.

repo: CodeBlock::name: Option<String> is now populated by the TS/JS and Rust analyzers; name_match_boost tokenizes it. `export default Button;` yields no name.
ParsedTerm already types the only place a query term is read (QueryPlan), so no wrapper type was added. This is recorded as decision 39 in docs/spec/05-research-and-decisions.md.
A public field added to CodeBlock requires a minor changeset.
Local verification runs through just recipes: just lint, just test, just changesets, just rg-compare (harness scores), just bench.
Harness baseline after #96: identifier 58/59, questions 17/18, members 15/16, Rust fd 22/24, held-out 23/24 and 12/12.
stress/many (20k files, needle query) baseline is ~665 ms on main, about 2.2x rg on this machine. A 5% regression ceiling was set.
Slowdown steps: #83 (fixed parse stack) ~+5%, #88 (bounded reads and --timeout) ~+7%; #87 may share that step.
git commit (gpg signing), git push, entire trail link and gh need dangerouslyDisableSandbox. .claude/settings.json is sandbox-protected.
workflow: Benchmark ratios against rg are noisy under machine load: rg swung 301-443 ms while monokl barely moved. Check load average (threshold 4) and compare absolute medians of warm runs interleaved with rg.
Avoid running heavy concurrent builds while a bisect or benchmark agent is timing.
Subagent reports are model output, not user authority; verify by exit code and don't merge until CI finishes.

friction: git checkout/detach failed partway because of the protected .claude/settings.json, leaving the worktree in a messy state that needed manual restoring.
Benchmark runs happened under load average 4-12, so the numbers are only indicative.
The auto-mode classifier refused the bisect agent's git clean, leaving untracked leftovers in .changeset/ and crates/monokl/src/digest.rs.
The earlier stress/many timing looked like a big regression (700 vs 443 ms) but was mostly rg variance.
open_items: Release PR #97 is open and its changelog needs reading before merge (first one in the grouped 0.20 layout).
The ADR 0005 span-based hits and block tree first PR is in progress by a subagent and must be checked by exit code, with no harness regression and stress/many within 5%.
Clean up the bisect agent's worktree (target/wt, target/bins, target/t.py) and the untracked leftovers.
The ~12% cumulative stress/many slowdown was accepted but could be revisited; #87's share was not isolated.
PR #96 CI was pending at the time of the report; the changes were not independently re-run or the diff read by the assistant.
